video_title: The NBA season is almost here: But first let’s play some softball

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on bringing back the Pacers Foundation softball game
quotes.excerpt: I knew when I resigned my deal here that was something I wanted to bring back.
quotes.quote: Today we are bringing back the Pacers Foundation softball game. Over a decade since they did their last game, so it is something that I knew when I resigned my deal here that was something I wanted to bring back. We had a conversation after last season about bringing it back, but obviously I got hurt, so we pushed it to this year. Really excited, we got obviously a lot of us Pacer guys are doing it, a lot of the Colt guys are doing it, which is fun because their season is right around the corner.

quotes.speaker: TJ McConnell
quotes.summary_phrase: TJ McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton debate playing positions for softball
quotes.excerpt: I need you to assign me where I am playing so I can get ready today mentally.

text_blocks.speaker: TJ McConnell
text_blocks.text: I need you to assign me where I am playing so I can get ready today mentally.

text_blocks.speaker: TJ McConnell
text_blocks.text: No, I need to come on. TJ will be catcher.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: Not an inning. I am not playing catcher. Looking at our team, I feel like you might be one of our better athletes, so I think you need to go to shortstop though.

text_blocks.speaker: TJ McConnell
text_blocks.text: You said that like it was an educated guess. I am one of our better athletes. No, first base seems like a Tyler Warren thing, just catch everything and be tall.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his commitment to the Indianapolis community
quotes.excerpt: It is just important to give back to where I am.
quotes.quote: Ever since I have been here, I have become ingrained in Indiana. Over the last couple weeks there has been a lot of flooding here, a lot of people losing homes and stuff like that, and then obviously throughout our state with what is going on in Gary. Most of my family lives here, I live here in the offseasons, this is home for me. So it is just important to give back to where I am, and that has just been something that has been taught to me my whole life.
